title: 중국산 더블레이어 인쇄제판용 평면 모양 사진플레이트에 대한 덤핑방지관세 부과에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 중국산 더블레이어 인쇄제판용 평면 모양 사진플레이트에 대한 덤핑방지관세 부과에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Goods Subject to Imposition)
Goods subject to anti-dumping duties shall be double-layer photosensitive plates in flat form for printing plate-making originating in China (meaning goods classified under tariff subheading No. 3701.30.2000 of the Harmonized Tariff and Statistical Classification of Goods under Article 98 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Customs Act) which meet all of the following requirements: Provided, That photopolymer violet plates and recycled plates shall be excluded.
1. They shall be photosensitive printing plates on which an oxide film has been formed by electrochemically polishing the surface of an aluminum plate and then applying a photosensitive coating to the surface twice;
2. Each side shall exceed 255 millimeters (mm) in length, and the photosensitive surface shall consist of two layers.
